steps.sub: one function, no network; hundreds in seconds

steps.label: Integration tests

steps.label: End-to-end tests
steps.sub: whole app like a user; slowest, fewest

code:
steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v4
  - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
  - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
  - name: Run unit tests
    run: pytest tests/unit --maxfail=1
  - name: Run integration tests
    run: pytest tests/integration
caption: pytest's exit code is the pass/fail gate — the pipeline never reads the output itself.
A pass/fail icon rides along with the commit — no need to open the Actions tab to check.
The Checks tab rolls up every job from every workflow before a reviewer opens the diff.

subtitle: Catching problems tests don't even look for
